Built from the small screen up

Responsive layout behavior
WidthLayout
Under 600pxSingle column, touch navigation, stacked cards
600px+Two court columns, more generous spacing
900px+Persistent sidebar, four summary cards
1200px+Split hero and session, four court columns
1450px+Expanded spacing and illustration

Spacing uses a 4px base. Touch targets are at least 44px for primary controls. Dialogs use native focus containment and Escape dismissal; a visible close button is always available. Motion follows the operating system’s reduced-motion preference. The dedicated television layout will be developed in Stage 9.

Stage 1 foundation · PWA manifest, service worker, offline page, and installation are planned for the final stage.
